author: nflaig
content:
can you open an alternative to how we wanna limit bids that is less strict than your PR and simpler

my proposal was something like this
```python
def is_bid_parent_candidate(store: Store, bid: ExecutionPayloadBid) -> bool:
    if bid.parent_block_root not in store.blocks:
        return False

    head = get_head(store)
    head_block = store.blocks[head.root]
    parent_block = store.blocks[bid.parent_block_root]
    return parent_block.slot >= head_block.slot or bid.parent_block_root == head_block.parent_root
```
but that means it could be from a block from different branch too, maybe that's even good? it definitely doesn't make sense to allow bids for any block as parent that exists in fork choice
